In the sprawling lands of Vana’diel, while the primary races maintain distinct societies, the whisper of mixed heritage, or “Half-Breeds,” is an undeniable undercurrent. These rare individuals are born from the unlikely unions of different sentient races, carrying within them the genetic tapestry and cultural echoes of two distinct peoples.

Note: This race isn’t bound by the RP limit like other races. Beware allowing players to use this race; like Freelancers, it is somewhat customizable and can get out of hand.

Banned Combinations: These combinations are unfit to breed or too far beyond normal humanoid form to produce an offspring: Antica, Galka, Genome, Gnath, Immortal, Mandragora, PuPu, Seto Lion, and Shindroid.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Racial Traits: Half-breed characters gain a +2 racial bonus to one ability score of their choice at creation to represent their varied nature.
  • Size: Half-breeds are the size of one of their parent races (player's choice), and receive bonuses and penalties accordingly.
  • Type: Half-breeds are humanoid creatures with the subtypes of both of their parent races.
  • Base Speed: Half-breeds have a base speed equal to half their combined movement speed from their base races. If one or more base races have a fly, climb, or burrow speed, half-breeds gain half that movement amount instead, or an average if both races possess the same movement mode.
  • Languages: Half-breeds begin play speaking Common and one other language from their chosen base races. Half-breeds with high Intelligence scores can choose any languages they want.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Select one Defense racial trait (of 3 RP or less) from either of the two base races.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Select one Feat and Skill racial trait (of 3 RP or less) from either of the two base races.

Magical Racial Traits

  • Select one Magical racial trait (of 3 RP or less) from either of the two base races.

Movement Racial Traits

  • Select one Movement racial trait (of 3 RP or less) from either of the two base races.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Select one Offense racial trait (of 3 RP or less) from either of the two base races.

Other Racial Traits

  • Blood: Half-breeds count as both their base races for any effect related to race.
  • Multitalented: Chosen at first level, half-breeds have two favored classes instead of one, giving them favored class bonuses when they take a level in either of those classes.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Select one Senses racial trait (of 3 RP or less) from either of the two base races.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Select one Weakness racial trait from either of the two base races, if any.

GM Note: This item deliberately carries no automated ability score, speed, or type changes because Half-Breed traits are fully variable and depend on the player's chosen parent races and selected traits. Manually add Changes / Context Notes to this race item once the parent races and traits are finalized.
